_comment: High and critical advisories in production dependencies that CI accepts for now. Each needs a reason and a review date. After that date CI fails until the advisory is fixed or the entry is reviewed again.

exceptions.reason: Only the Prisma CLI's config loader uses it (@prisma/config). It is not in the api image. In the migrate image it merges only this repository's own Prisma settings, so no outside input reaches it. The fix is in 8.0.0, a major version that Prisma 6 does not use.

Only the Prisma CLI's config loader uses it (@prisma/config). It is not in the api image. The fault needs Schema.TemplateLiteral to decode outside input, and the CLI in the migrate image takes none. The fix, 3.22.1 or later, needs a lockfile change.

@atomic-ui/design-tokens uses it to read this repository's own brand file in the theme build script and its test. It is not in the web bundle or in any image's run-time files. The fix, 4.6.6 or later, needs a lockfile change.
